metadata.title: India Government Careers & Live Recruitment Hub
metadata.scope: Live government career and recruitment tracker with current 2026-2027 application cycles, exact dates, vacancies, exam schedules, and direct application links.
importantLimitations: Dates and vacancies are dynamically synchronized with official 2026–2027 recruitment calendars.
Always double check for any last-minute date extension notices or corrigenda on the direct official gateway.
Fee payment timestamps usually close on the same day as online submission; apply at least 48 hours before deadline.

applicationChecklist.Check: Identify exact post and recruitment year
applicationChecklist.What to verify: Write the advertisement number, post code and recruiting body; ignore unofficial summaries when they conflict.
Record degree/course name, recognition, compulsory subjects, aggregate/subject percentage, grade conversion and qualification cutoff date.
Nationality; exact DOB window/age cutoff; category, disability, ex-serviceman and certificate formats/validity; attempts where applicable.
Domicile, district cadre, language, local reservation and other-state open-category rules.
Height/chest/endurance/vision/medical; council registration, licence, experience and skill speeds.
CTET/TET/NET/GATE qualifying does not by itself create an appointment. Check the employer’s separate application.
Opening date, normal closing timestamp, payment deadline, correction window and any official extension. Do not use this guide’s watch month as the deadline.
Read every corrigendum, revised calendar, court-order-related change and cancellation before paying.
Save original notice, fee receipt, submitted form and acknowledgement from the official portal.

monthPlanner.How to use this safely: Historical planning pattern only; yearly calendar and detailed notice override.
Two cycles do not imply fixed day/month deadlines.
Application year and exam year may differ.
Different notices and deadlines; not one combined application.
2026–27 original calendar is tentative and may be superseded. Do not treat its planned month as a live closing date.

monthPlanner.Application watch window: Individual notices; often mid-year for some cadres
monthPlanner.How to use this safely: Calendar gives examination dates; it does NOT establish the application closing month.
No dependable shared annual closing month.
Large drives need not be annual; multiple CENs can overlap.
Separate fee windows and extensions; PSU job applications are separate.

monthPlanner.Exam watch window: Cycle labels may differ from actual examination month
monthPlanner.How to use this safely: Do not infer application deadline from the cycle name.
TNPSC publishes a planner; this does not establish dates for other states.
No single all-India exam or closing month for these families.

Nationality; exact DOB window/age cutoff; category, disability, ex-serviceman and certificate formats/validity; attempts where applicable.
Domicile, district cadre, language, local reservation and other-state open-category rules.
Height/chest/endurance/vision/medical; council registration, licence, experience and skill speeds.
CTET/TET/NET/GATE qualifying does not by itself create an appointment. Check the employer’s separate application.
Opening date, normal closing timestamp, payment deadline, correction window and any official extension. Do not use this guide’s watch month as the deadline.
Read every corrigendum, revised calendar, court-order-related change and cancellation before paying.
Save original notice, fee receipt, submitted form and acknowledgement from the official portal.
